Private Equity

Capital with capability for your business.

Common questions.

Something else on your mind? Call 03 7076 1095 or book a call.

How much does it cost?

Every engagement starts with a free discovery consultation. After that, each stage is quoted as a fixed fee before we begin, and ongoing partnership is on a monthly or success-fee basis. You’ll always know the cost upfront.

Do I have to commit to every stage?

No. Each stage stands on its own with a clear deliverable. You can start with Discover and decide what comes next once you’ve seen the blueprint.

Is my business ready for AI?

That’s what Discover answers. We get operational clarity first, then recommend AI only where it delivers a clear, fully costed return against your goals.

Will AI replace my team?

Our approach is to automate repeatable work so your people can focus on higher-value work. We map every role first, so any change is deliberate and planned with you.

What kinds of businesses do you work with?

Established, owner-led Australian SMEs across a wide range of industries.

How does private equity work?

We consider growth capital, majority acquisitions and succession or exit opportunities with established Australian SMEs. Every conversation is treated in confidence. The best first step is a discovery call.

Ready to grow with purpose?
